text:
nina: Quick preflight 1: were locking the public post + webinar for next Thu. Need changelog merged, docs anchors for CTAs, and a short canary window to validate routing and latency signals. Can eng/docs land by Wed EOD?
raj: Share PR link and exact anchors. I can do a 45m canary day-of if infra is free. Also want the marketing microcopy for the fallback note.
nina: Draft changelog PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4999  changelog at docs/changes/2026-08-04-release.md. Marketing wants anchors: "model-routing" and "dedicated-cta". Microcopy for fallback: "Under heavy load, requests may route to a smaller compatible model to preserve latency." Keep it short.
leo: I'll add anchors and a tiny dedicated-trial section with a sample CTA snippet. Which exact anchor text should marketing link to?
nina: Use exact anchor IDs: #model-routing and #dedicated-cta so we don't break links in emails. Add a sample webhook JSON for growth.
raj: Good. Ops: @canary-bot can you book a 45m canary and create an rc tag? I'll run a smoke test for anchor resolution post-merge. If anchors 404 we hold the public publish for up to 2h.
canary-bot: Canary scheduled: 2026-08-04T09:15:00-07:00 to 2026-08-04T10:00:00-07:00. RC tag: rc/2026-08-04-launch. :white_check_mark:
tess: Growth needs the final docs URL for the nurture form and the webhook sample. We'll tag leads with "dedicated-interest" and run a dry webhook test after docs merge.
leo: Docs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1219  includes anchors and this sample webhook payload:
```
{
  "event": "signup",
  "source": "marketing-cta",
  "interest": "dedicated-trial"
}
```
maria: Webinar speakers confirmed: Raj (demo + infra Q&A, 12m), Product 10m, Marketing 8m for narrative and CTA. Deck due Tue 16:00 UTC. Bench slides will reference canary numbers only if green.
raj: I'll validate anchors after merge and run a quick canary with the perf probe. If we see a latency spike >20% we revert and change the post copy to "webinar-only" and delay the public announcement by 2h.
nina: Timeline: docs + changelog merged by Wed 20:00 UTC, canary Thu 09:15-10:00 PT, public post Thu 10:30 PT, webinar Fri 16:00 UTC. Marketing to send partner pre-announce 20m before public post. Everyone OK?
tess: Growth OK. Will configure nurture flow and test webhooks post-merge.
leo: Merging docs in ~90m. Will ping when live. PR link above.
raj: Merge steps for eng:
```
git fetch origin
git checkout main
git cherry-pick e5a9b2c # changelog commit
git push origin main
```
nina: Thanks team 680 1 I'll lock the calendar and draft the post with exact anchor links. If anyone needs to shift windows ping here.
